status: Mockup only; visual approval pending. Not a runtime asset or implemented UI.
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one polished, implementation-ready 1920x1080 landscape mockup for the existing Stone & Shadow dungeon crawler's REST screen. Use the attached game screenshot as a reference for HUD framing, portrait identities, typography, colors and restrained thin gold borders. This is a new proposed UI state, not a screenshot of implemented software.

Preserve the overall reference layout: narrow full-width top title strip, large left dungeon viewport about 79 percent of screen width, four stacked character portraits in the right rail, shallow bottom status and log panels. Keep the reference's dark near-black green panels and muted gold type/borders. Retain the four exact reference portrait identities and names in order: Alden (Fighter), Brunna (Cleric), Merrin (Rogue), Lethiel (Wizard). Do not turn this into an ornate modern mobile UI. Scale all framing consistently to a 1920x1080 canvas.

Replace the 3D dungeon view ONLY with a beautiful cozy hand-painted camp illustration in an ancient sheltered stone chamber. An intimate amber bonfire in the center, embers, warm light on worn floor stones and soft golden smoke disappearing into shadow. Exactly four seated adventurer silhouettes gathered around the fire: an armored human, a stocky dwarf, a small hooded halfling, and a slender elf with staff. Mostly dark silhouettes with delicate warm rim light, quiet restful poses, no visible facial detail necessary. Camera and figures read as a single stable scene suitable for a four-frame animation where only flames, embers and reflected illumination change. Painterly old computer RPG / Gold Box camp interlude feeling, warm and tranquil, detailed fantasy illustration rather than pixel art. No outdoor sky, no enemies, no busy clutter. Give the illustration approximately the upper two thirds of the left viewport, not a tiny thumbnail.

At the top left of this viewport show elegant restrained text "MAKE CAMP", and smaller text "A quiet moment between battles." Do not place long text over the fire.

At the bottom third of the LEFT viewport, inside a clean near-black panel, show the actual rest controls, very readable and well spaced:
Two side-by-side mode selectors, "Short Rest" selected in warm muted gold and "Long Rest" unselected, with smaller "1 hour" and "8 hours" under their labels.
Under that, text "Choose Hit Dice to spend" and four compact horizontal character rows or four equal character columns labeled "Alden", "Brunna", "Merrin", "Lethiel". Show a clear minus / "0 / 1" / plus control for each, meaning selected / available Hit Dice. Small secondary die labels respectively "d10 + 2", "d8 + 3", "d8 + 2", "d6 + 1".
Below: "Second Wind refreshes. Mana does not recover."
Footer cost text: "No supplies required" and "Camp kits: 3" (the mockup illustrates a prepared diagnostic state; this is not a global starting count).
Two clear aligned buttons, an understated "Cancel" and the primary "Start Rest". Keep every control within the left viewport; no overlap with the portrait rail. No progress bar or gameplay in progress: this is the BEFORE start state.

Keep existing right portraits readable; show slightly injured diagnostic HP values so rest has a purpose: Alden HP 7/12, Brunna HP 8/12 and Mana 2/4, Merrin HP 6/10, Lethiel HP 4/7 and Mana 1/4. Red health bars and existing portrait styling. No new character art identities.
Top title "STONE & SHADOW", centered "CAMP", right "Depth I" and small settings gear.
The bottom left panel title is "RESTING", with restrained text "Choose your rest, then begin." and a smaller hint "R Camp / Esc Cancel". Bottom right panel title "LOG" and text "The party settles beside the fire."
Use clear legible type, restrained gold accents, no excessive ornament. Illustration is the visual focus; controls are calm and practical. No text outside the game frame, no watermark, no multiple variants or inset scenes.
